title: fix(lint,objectql)!: a formula reading a field its lookup target does not declare is refused at save, and no longer nulls its sibling formulas
body:
Fixes #24410

Clause-②: no (narrowing) (the save door newly refuses a formula it accepted; owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review, on the narrowing face, before the queue)

Dispatched by the `domain:engine` seat 1 PM (claim 6258777300). Developer session: `session_01SE5iTKQC8i5LBRywMuQZmt`.

## What changes

**Save refusal (lint, `judgeFieldFormula`).** The field-formula pass now judges the field a formula reads one hop through a reference against the target object's field index: its declared fields, the system columns the platform injects on it, and `id`. A read of a field the target does not declare is refused under the existing `EXPRESSION_INVALID` rule (`expression-invalid`). No new code. The message opens in the shared validator's `unknown field` words and names the field and the target: "unknown field `name` on `rhf_book`: this formula reads it through the reference `record.book` ...". The same pass runs for `os validate`, `os build` and the object save door.

- At the save door the snapshot carries the live registry's objects in the written package's closure. So a target from a package the written one depends on is judged, and a system object is always judged.
- A target outside the snapshot is not judged. That is a missed catch, never a false refusal.
- A hop into the stored-metadata-body family stays with `refuseStoredMetadataBodyHop` and is not judged twice.

**Sibling isolation (objectql, `resolveFormulaRelated`).** Measured cause: no driver read failed. The formula read merged every formula's hop columns per reference. The shared one-hop loader then answered the whole reference `undeclared-field` when any column was undeclared. So the valid sibling read `null` and reported the bad formula's field: "the formula reads 'name' through `book`". The fix:

- `resolveFormulaRelated` takes the undeclared columns out of the shared read.
- `formulaHopScope` judges them per formula.
- A bad formula reads `null` with its existing `undeclared-field` fault report, which now names only its own columns.
- A valid sibling is served from the same single read, exactly as it is alone.
- The predicate seam's use of the loader is byte-for-byte unchanged. The declared-field test moved into one helper, `undeclaredRelatedFields`, that both seams share.

**The WARN text.** "a re-save of the object, refuses it with a located message" now holds for this fault: a re-save of the object answers 422 with the located refusal (measured below). Left unchanged.

⛔ No change to which records a formula may read: the #24316 / #24358 family guards are untouched.

## Verification (M, booted composition: `bootStack`, real ObjectQL, SQL driver, REST, auth, metadata)

Pin: `packages/qa/dogfood/test/formula-hop-undeclared-related-field.dogfood.test.ts`. The fixture is `rhf_book` (title), `rhf_reader` (reader_name) and `rhf_loan`. The loan has a valid `summary` formula (`joinNonEmpty([record.book.title, record.reader.reader_name], ' · ')`) and a code-declared bad `bad_title` (`record.book.name`).

| Measurement | Before (`main` `db1f1fd`) | After (head) |

| `PUT /meta/object/rhf_loan_saved` with `record.book.name` | **200** `Saved object 'rhf_loan_saved'` | **422** `INVALID_METADATA`, one issue: rule `expression-invalid`, where `object 'rhf_loan_saved' · field 'summary' expression`, message `unknown field \`name\` on \`rhf_book\` ...` |
| Control: the same save with `record.book.title` | 200 | 200 |
| Control: `GET /data/rhf_loan?fields=summary` (valid alone) | `RHFBOOK71 · RHFREADER72` | `RHFBOOK71 · RHFREADER72` |
| `GET /data/rhf_loan`: `summary` / `bad_title` | `null` / `null`, and WARN on `summary`: "reads 'name' through `book`" | `RHFBOOK71 · RHFREADER72` / `null`, with WARN on `bad_title` only |
| `GET /data/rhf_loan/:id`: `summary` / `bad_title` | `null` / `null` | value / `null` |

Unit pins:

- `engine-formula-one-hop.test.ts`: the sibling is served as alone, ONE book read with fields `id,title`, and only the bad formula reports.
- `validate-expressions.formula-one-hop.test.ts`: the refusal names the field and the target. `id` and an injected column (`created_at`) are admitted. A target the stack does not carry is not judged.
- `runtime-gate.object-formula-writes.test.ts`: at the door, the target comes from another package the written one depends on. The refusal is LIT and the declared-field read is the CONTROL.

**Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` wrap form, then `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`). Each restore was checked against the HEAD blob with an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- **Refusal.** In `refuseUndeclaredHopField`, `if (column === 'id' || ...) continue;` became an always-continue carrying the marker `ABLATED_24410`.
  - lint build exit 0. Marker present in 4 `dist/` files.
  - Red: 2 lint pins (`refuses a read of a field the target does not declare`, the door `LIT`), and the booted save case.
  - The first attempt deleted the call instead. The lint build then exited 1 on the unused closure, so it was redone. The pins were red on that attempt too.
- **Isolation.** In `formulaHopScope`, `own` became every undeclared column of the reference, not this formula's own.
  - objectql build exit 0. Marker in 4 `dist/` files.
  - Red: the objectql sibling pin and the booted sibling case.
  - The booted save case was also red on this run, because ablation 1's restore had not rebuilt `lint/dist` yet. That redness belongs to ablation 1.
- **Restore legs.** lint and objectql rebuilt (exit 0). `--absent` checks: marker absent from all 20 lint and all 14 objectql built files. Booted pin 3/3.

**Corpus.** No formula field the repository ships reads through a reference: 28 formula fields across examples (app-crm, app-showcase, app-todo) and platform display titles. So the pass refuses nothing it accepted in-tree.

Then `origin/main` `fa26308bb` was merged in (head `313ee1040`). It brings #24423, which touches `objectql/hook-binder.ts`: the hook body's `ctx.title`, which `serveFormulaField` → `resolveFormulaRelated` serves. It also moves `packages/spec`. On `313ee1040`:

Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths) on `313ee1040` gives 75 commands. Each was run with its exit code recorded, and all 75 exited 0.

- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 on the earlier head (8 packages outside the dogfood closure had no `dist/`). They were built, and it exits 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **The predicate seam has the same union verdict (read-only inference, not measured at a door).** `resolvePredicateRelated` hands the shared loader every rule's hop columns per reference. So one validation rule naming a field its target does not declare leaves every rule through that reference without a verdict. The lint added here judges formula `expression`s only, not hydrated rule `condition`s. The fence leaves that seam unchanged. Dedupe words: validation rule undeclared related field, predicate hop sibling refusal, rule traversal related field existence.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx`'s "Field must exist" row does not mention the one-hop read. It does not misstate the new behaviour, so it was left alone.
